notes.title: Chinese Dubbing and Profile Update
notes.content:
The long-awaited Chinese dubbing is here! Thank you to all our Chinese-speaking broadcasters for their patience but we are very happy to announce that NFB is now completely dubbed into Mandarin.

And not just that, oh no! We've also decided to completely redesign how we save your progress.

The game now has a 'Profile' system where all of your individual save games and playthroughs, rushes, adverts, epilogues and rewards are saved together under an overarching Profile.
All of your progress is kept together in one place, and you can have as many profiles as you'd like, so your Grandma can start her own game if she wants. You go grandma.

If you're new to the game, simply create a profile and you're good to go. Existing players can either combine their existing saves into a profile, convert individual games or start a new one. We save your Legacy saves in case you want to convert them later, but feel free to delete them to save space on your system.

We hope you're all staying safe and well. Our love goes out to all of our Broadcasters facing difficult times.

NotGames x

notes.title: The 'Play Your Way' Update is OUT NOW
notes.content:
We did it! Another update.

[previewyoutube=5b0w8920c5g;full][/previewyoutube]

First, as always a quick thank you to all the Broadcasters that have brought Not For Broadcast to this point. We are now frighteningly close to beginning principal photography on Episode Three, but first,  it’s time for another update - and it’s a big one! 

Alongside bug fixes and optimisations the Play Your Way Update includes:

[h2]Full Controller Support[/h2]
You can now play the entire game on the controller of your choice - with fully-remappable controls and on-screen prompts.

[h2]Difficulty Modes[/h2]
Whether you’re a veteran broadcaster looking for a new challenge, or if all that stress just isn’t your vibe - there’s a mode for you. NFB now includes 3 levels of difficulty: Intern, Broadcaster and Showrunner. At each level the broadcast room is more intense, and the audience at home more fickle. 

[h2]Story Mode[/h2]
On top of that we’re introducing Story Mode. Here you can focus on enjoying the story of NFB without any of the stress. Edit the news without those pesky extra mechanics and multi-tasking to worry about. 

[h2]Customisable Gameplay[/h2]
But we’ve gone EVEN FURTHER. We are now putting the power in players’ hands to truly ‘Play Your Way’. 
In the past, we’ve been reticent about changing the core experience of the game because we believe that the feeling of stress is integral to the story we are telling. But we also believe that players should be able to play their games in the way that works best for them. So, although we have our vision for how we think Not For Broadcast should feel to players, we want to hand that decision to you.
New Custom Difficulty allows you to individually alter the difficulty of, or even turn off, certain mechanics if they are negatively affecting your experience of the game.

[h2]Accessibility Settings[/h2]
We’ve added a range of accessibility settings to support our players with various visual, audio and motor needs. You can now change the size, colour and background of subtitles, remove confusing visual effects, turn on visual HUD cues, as well as extensive colourblind support where important colours can be individually customised. 

[h2]Alternate Video Format[/h2]
We now have a version of the game with an alternate video player with the video content in a different format for systems that aren’t displaying video correctly. To download it, right click Not for Broadcast and go to Properties. Under the Betas tab select Alternate Video and redownload the game. 

We hope you enjoy this latest batch of features, but there’s no time to relax!
We’ll be shooting the ending of the game over the summer in our longest and most complicated shoot yet. Simultaneously we’ll be beavering away on an overhaul to the Challenges. Our next update is still on schedule for the end of Summer/start of Autumn. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1147550/view/3084377958535890051 ]You can read more about the future of NFB in the roadmap here.[/url] 

Thanks to all of you for your support and a big thank you to our Accessibility Focus Group for their feedback. 

Keep Broadcasting,
NotGames

notes.title: Community requests, a new roadmap and a big thank you
notes.content:
Hi there! We wanted to take this opportunity to say our thanks and let you in on a few plans for Not For Broadcast’s future. 

Here's a quick video from us to you, and below it is a more detailed breakdown of our upcoming plans:
[previewyoutube=3EuGcCysXj0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Thank you![/h1]

Thanks for checking out Not For Broadcast - whether you’ve bought, streamed, tweeted about, reviewed, chatted or rang up your mum about our game then thank you, it all means the world.

There’s no way we could have expected that with over 1000 reviews we’d be at 97% positive, or that we’d make the front page of Steam for so long. 

We decided to stream upon launch for what we’d thought might be 4-5 hours, to say hi to you all and celebrate what we’d achieved together. That stream turned out to be 12 hours, and we ended up doing it again and again until we ended up at around 26 hours worth of streaming in the first 55 hours after launch. 

Above all, the most amazing thing that happened was when people on our streams bought copies for other viewers, complete strangers they never spoke to before - we can’t accurately express how incredible it is to see that kind of generosity, let alone to see it involving our game.

[h1]Community Requests [/h1]

We’ve been paying attention to the feedback and requests you’ve given us through launch, and we’ve begun planning a few new tweaks and additions to the game we think you might like. (Some of these have been implemented in the first month of patches (things like adding in a Level Select and being able to Hang Up the Tutorial).)

[h2]Requests already added[/h2]
[list][*] Level Select
[*] Hanging up the tutorial[/list]

[h2]Other Requests[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Scoring system[/b] rework: audience reaction should be positive to viewing certain backstage footage (the moment where Blunderclatch blows up after his interview comes to mind - currently the audience switches off if you show this, but a large section of our players have pointed out, and rightly so, it would make more sense for audience to go up at this point, but for your boss to be unhappy with you instead)
[*] A [b]“challenge mode”[/b]: to really test your skills when editing Broadcasts. We’re hoping the addition of Free Play in the Gameplay Update will cater to this as well as providing a fun new way to play the game and earn specific rewards.
[*] [b]Backstage/Behind the Scenes content[/b]: Things like blooper reels, videos showing the process of actually making the game, that sort of thing. We’ve actually taken on board a videographer to help out with the backstage stuff now we know you guys want to see it! 
[*] [b]Not For Broadcast OST[/b]: Almost all the music in Not For Broadcast is written/composed/performed in-house by Jason Orbaum, with some help from some other rather talented individuals (full details can be found in the game’s credits!). Having long ago done a comedy album for one of our previous much smaller and less substantial titles, we’re quite keen to release an OST for this one as well! 
[*][b] Revamp the Archive[/b]: The most frequent request that we have plans to implement in our first big Gameplay Update is to revamp the Archive/Rushes room. In addition to doing some general tidying up of these areas, we’ll be adding a Fast Forward/Rewind function to the tapes, to give much more flexibility for players wanting to watch back previous Broadcasts or see the bits they weren’t supposed to show live on air.[/list]

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
So you can all have a good nosy at what we’re up to, here’s our current roadmap:
[i]All of the below are priority targets, and do not form an exhaustive list of content to be added/updated.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35733451/5ace6873b4c982fa5b2e10c8a970a1cfeb988674.png[/img]

[h1]Upcoming Secret Opportunity ([i]shh..[/i])[/h1]
To round out this update, you may have heard rumours that we’re currently casting for new episodes of Not For Broadcast. Well, we’d really like to involve you guys by opening up that process to you. 

That’s right - you might be in with a chance to be an extra in a scene featured on the National Nightly News.

We’re still figuring out the logistics, but rest assured we’ll be back in touch as and when we have them. We want to really give back and thank you guys for all your support, and this opportunity will only be the start.

We’ve also set up a brand new Not For Broadcast newsletter which will let you in on a few behind the scenes secrets and updates - you may already be signed up if you’ve entered your email on the tinyBuild or NotGames website - [url=https://tinybuild.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=7c5ba06b8b6710be2a32d1afc&id=49663b07f5 email subscription link ]but the link to join is here[/url].

Thanks again, you absolute beauties -
[b]The NotGames team.[/b]

Sign up to our newsletter: [url=https://bit.ly/2ItQamw]https://bit.ly/2ItQamw[/url]

notes.title: Week 1 Patches and Fixes!
notes.content:
This is the first patch for Not For Broadcast.
We only launched last Thursday so, as I’m sure you can imagine, it’s been quite a week for us!
We are thrilled with the response and all the amazing news reviews (apparently we’re Overwhelmingly Positive, which isn’t bad for a group of grumpy cynics) and we are listening to all your suggestions and taking them on board. 
Pre-production for “Episode 2” has begun and we have a heap of surprises planned for you along the way.
There’s only a couple of new features in this patch but hopefully they’ll deal with two of the most requested things on the forums and in the reviews:

[list]
[*]You can now delete your saved games, and we are working hard to fix the issue with stuttering videos and people experiencing video lag.
[*]As a first attempt to solve this problem you can now reduce the TV video resolution to “Half” in the options menu. While this will not solve the problem for everyone, it should alleviate it for some. We are working hard on this and are determined to get the game running smoothly for as many people as possible!
[/list]
WINDOWS 7 USERS EXPERIENCING VIDEO PROBLEMS: We hear you! We’re pouring all of our (severely limited) expertise and intelligence into working out why you’re experiencing video issues. We hope to have a fix for you really soon. Experts have been summoned. Theories are being tested and many thoughts are being thunk.

Here’s the short (but perfectly formed) list of wondrous embellishments:
New Features:
• There is now the option to play the game with half resolution videos.
• Save games can now be deleted.
Bug fixes:
• Play advert buttons incorrectly unlocking during headlines fixed.
• English subtitles incorrectly appearing when playing in non-english languages fixed.
• Some spelling errors corrected.

To wrap up, a shout-out to those who have been chatting with us on our Live Streams - we’re on twitch and Steam - we love hearing from you.
But mostly our thanks to those of you who are telling your friends and fellow gamers about our weird little game. Word of mouth and the recommendation of a friend means more than a million trailers so to our advocates and friends, new and old, avatars or real fleshy human things, our sincere and heartfelt thanks.
See you in the next list of “things none of us knew were wrong with our game but we’re happy to admit to now that we’ve fixed them”.
Love and pizza, Community.
NotGames
